title: Deformation rigidity for Z/2 eigensections
summary: We prove a rigidity result for certain critical Z/2 eigensections of the Laplacian on S^2 associated to a flat real line bundle determined by a branch-point configuration. More precisely, we show that every minimal non-degenerate critical eigensection is deformation rigid: any sufficiently small deformation of the configuration that still admits a critical eigensection must come from an SO(3)-rotation. This generalizes the rigidity phenomenon previously discovered in symmetric examples of Taubes-Wu.
